## 4 Latin American countries in one journey

After the nature-focused part of the trip, you continue to Buenos Aires and Santiago de Chile. In Argentina's capital, the programme includes a city tour and a free day. In Chile, you explore historic and modern Santiago, Viña del Mar and Valparaíso.

The final days take you to Peru. You will travel to the Sacred Valley of the Incas, visit Pisac, Ollantaytambo, Chinchero, Moray and Awanakancha, then take the train to Machu Picchu. Before your flight to Lima, the programme continues in Cusco, Sacsayhuamán, Qorikancha, Tambomachay and Puka Pukara.

On the last day, you will explore Lima's colonial centre, the [San Francisco Monastery](/peru/place/san-francisco-monastery-lima/), [San Isidro](/peru/place/san-isidro-lima/) and Miraflores. After the city tour, you return to the hotel and transfer to the airport for your international departure.

The route brings together different sides of the continent in a single trip. Brazil offers the ocean, rainforest and waterfalls; Argentina, a major South American metropolis and tango; Chile, the Pacific coast and modern Santiago; and Peru, Inca heritage and highland valleys. Every few days, the architecture, climate and cultural setting change completely.
